name: @lmthing/dsh-space-delegate
description: Self-loading dsh plugin: given { spaceDir, agentSlug, registry }, maps canDelegateTo onto @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-subagent mounts. See dsh/packages/README.md for the architectural nuance this package works around (dsh in-process subagents JOIN the parent's own preset rather than mounting a distinct one).
